title: Today's grouping and featured order
description: References event ids in the same day's events asset. Readers apply the user's SportsPriorityStore order on top of this default order.

featured_event_ids.description: Metadata release: the top display_policy.featured_event_count (10) of today's core events by feature_rank, best first (previously every event carrying a featured tag).

ordered_event_ids.description: Optional. Every core event of today, best first: feature_rank descending, then start_utc, then id.

today_extra_ids.description: Optional. Ids of today's tier 'extra' events (published in events_extra:<date>), best first. Never dropped; ids are the same as in events_extra.

today_extra_summary.description: Optional. Count of today's extra events and the count per sport id.
